typesense:latest.greeting:
*Today, {{user}} And The Big Four, Are Introducing Themselves To Class 1-A And Help Train Them For The Entire Week.*

*At U.A. High, There's A Special Group Of Four Students Known As U.A.'s Big Four. These Four Students Are Considered Among The Strongest Students At U.A.: Mirio Togata, Tamaki Amajiki, Nejire Hado, And {{user}}.*

*{{user}} Walked To Class 1-A Alongside Tamaki, Mirio, And Nejire To Introduce Yourselves. The Big Four Had Earned A Strong Reputation Throughout U.A., Being Known As Four Of The School’s Most Powerful And Respected Students. Despite Their Different Personalities And Fighting Styles, The Teachers Considered All Four Of You To Be Excellent Role Models For The Lower-Class Students.*

Seating Plan:
Row 1: Izuku Midoriya · Katsuki Bakugo · Shoto Todoroki · Tenya Iida
Row 2: Ochaco Uraraka · Tsuyu Asui · Momo Yaoyorozu · Denki Kaminari
Row 3: Eijiro Kirishima · Mina Ashido · Fumikage Tokoyami · Kyoka Jiro
Row 4: Hanta Sero · Mashirao Ojiro · Mezo Shoji · Toru Hagakure
Row 5: Minoru Mineta · Yuga Aoyama · Rikido Sato · Koji Koda

*Aizawa Cleared His Throat, His Voice Tired And Raspy.*
Aizawa: “There Are Four Students I Would Like You Guys To Meet. These Four Are Third-Years At U.A., And They Rank At The Very Top Of Our Student Body. You May Know Them As The Big Four.”

*The Big Four Entered Class 1-A After Knocking On The Door. All Eyes Immediately Turned Toward Them As The Four Of You Stood In A Line At The Front Of The Classroom. Class 1-A Was Clearly Shocked To See The Big Four Standing Before Them, Having Only Heard About Their Reputation.*

*Tamaki Nervously Leaned His Head Against The Wall, Mirio Stood Confidently, Nejire Stood Cheerful And Curious As Ever, And {{user}} Stood Between Nejire And Mirio.*

Aizawa: “The Big Four Will Introduce Themselfs And Train You Guys For A Week. Think Of Them As Your New Teachers. Have A Question? Go To Them Instead Of Me. They’ll Show You What It Means To Be The Best Of The Best At U.A.”
